title: Surprise Shahada! Jack Accepts Islam! | Muhammed Ali - Speakers Corner
normalized_text: OK Jack, I'll bring you on now, it's finally we got you! OK.. are you OK with your camera on or you want to turn it off? – I’m a bit.. right.. yeah! – How are you Jack? – I’m good, thank you! – How old are you Jack if I may ask? – I'm 17 – You're 17 OK, I feel you got a bit nervous don't be there's no need to be nervous, you're doing the right thing because you're doing it for Allahﷻ – Yeah! – You're not doing it for anyone else, You're not doing it for me you're not doing it for the people, always.. I mean purify your intention, You see something to be the truth you want to submit to The Creator of the universe, you want to worship Allah in the way that pleases Him right? – Yeah, – And you want to hopefully reach Paradise, We all want to hopefully reach Paradise, so do you want to accept Islam or do you have a question before you do Or you just want to accept Islam? You're ready, you feel you're ready? – Yeah, I think I'm ready – OK Alhamdulillah (praise be to God) so let me ask you first, How were you introduced to Islam? Do you have a friend or you’ve watched videos? – Well like.. I had a friend and then I kind of just explored it myself – OK, Alhamdulillah, are you in the UK? – Aha – OK that's good so it'd be easier for me to maybe get people to talk to you on this Inshallah (if God wills) Maybe take you to the Mosque and this and that.. OK if you repeat after me I'll say it in English first then in Arabic OK? – OK – Say: I testify there's nothing worthy of worship except Allah and I testify that Prophet Muhammad is His Messenger and Servant That's it you say the same thing in Arabic now, that is very easy don't worry OK, say: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ That’s it you’re a Muslim now Mashallah (God has willed it), I’d have hugged you but it’s from the screen I can't.. virtual hug you know! – Thank you! – I’m happy for you brother, Mashallah I mean you’re welcome to Islam.. look people in the comments are very happy Mashallah, Make Dua (supplication) for the brother Mashallah! Allahu Akbar! (God is Greatest) They’re all happy for you, and you have now two billion brothers and sisters wherever you go anything you need, You have.. and by the way I want to tell you this in.. my Email anything you need, because you are in the UK, Anything, any financial help you need, anything you need don't hesitate to let me know I need this or I need that, So you know Muslims we believe the most important thing is to believe in Allahﷻ alone, is the unity of Allah we call it توحيد Tawheed Which is you give all your full gratitude, all your worship to Allah ﷻ alone and you do not associate any partners with Him, And to follow the Message of the Prophet ﷺ which is what you did right now, which is we call the Shahada (Testimony of Faith) Then you have the Prayer, we have five prayers I'm sure you know that Muslims pray five times a day – Yeah – Then we have Zakat which is an obligatory charity, Two and a half percent of our wealth if you're wealthy enough you will give, then you have Fasting Ramadan I'm sure you know but it's very.. A couple of months is going to be Ramadan, I am sure you will enjoy And then winter is easy here by the way it's much easier, if you go to another country with this heat is harder to fast, But here it's much easier for you to fast, you don't get thirsty or this or that because it's cold, And then you've got Pilgrimage which you go to Mecca you do the Pilgrimage OK? – Yeah – And we have six articles of Faith, six things that we believe is that: We believe in Allahﷻ alone, we believe in His books; previous Revelations That have been changed now except the Quran the only book that is not changed, Believe in the Messengers of God; Previous Messengers, we believe in Destiny, we believe in the Angels of God, and we believe in The Day Of Judgement, So we believe things happen for a reason, they don't just happen so there's a reason for you to come here today, The reason for you to listen, Allahﷻ saw sincerity from you and He saw that you want to accept Islam Mashallah your smile is beautiful – Hahaha – Mashallah we're happy Wallah to see you – Thank you – And I will take your number please email me your number, – So you know my Email or should I put it in the private chat? – Oh yeah, I'll get it, yeah, OK so I'll put it to you just in the private chat just in case, and then you can just email me your phone number, And then I will connect you with people will teach you how to pray, and you need the Quran, you have a Quran or not yet? – No, not yet – So how do you feel? – I don't know! Like clean, Mashallah! Wallahi it’s a beautiful thing to say, Mashallah! and you know there's nothing that makes Muslims happier than to see someone who's: We believe saved, someone who's closer to enter Paradise, someone who if he dies upon his belief he will enter Paradise, There's nothing more happier for us as Muslims, did you freeze or are you still there? – Yeah, I’m back – Oh, you freeze for a little bit no problem, you freeze with a smile which is a good thing hahaha – So how many friends do you have? You have a lot of Muslim friends or..? – Just a few really, not many – OK Alhamdulillah, so they're here in the UK. What countries are they from? – Pakistan mostly – Pakistan, did they speak to you about Islam, did they tried to invite you to Islam or – Yeah – OK Alhamdulillah that's good, and if you’ve read the Quran yet or you have not read it? – Part of it – Part of it, that’s good – Not full of it yeah – You have the time, So now I'll tell you what the most important thing is: do not overwhelm yourself, meaning do not take too much information at once, take it step by step OK? And read the Quran in the meantime just focus on reading the Quran and I will connect you with people will teach you the basics On how to pray and all of that, it's just the basics for now, reading the Quran and learning how to pray, nothing else should.. Don't worry about that you'll get a lot of maybe crazy Muslims say Oh don't do this don't know that, don't listen to them, Don't worry about them for now just take it step by step, and always know that the religion represents itself not the people, Because sometimes you might have bad experiences with the people right? – Yeah, – So always know the religion represents itself, is the Truth, it's from Allahﷻ And there's millions, billions of brothers and sisters who are happy that you're a Muslim and they will help you in anything that you need and you'll answer.. By the way and you have my Email if you have any questions, – Yeah! – Anything like that make sure that you contact me Inshallah, is there anything you want to say? – Umm.. No! No, Hahaha – Alhumdulillah you said the best thing, you said the Shahada That's the most important thing, so for now Inshallah take it easy, step by step, and know as I said to you that you took the right decision Because you made it for Allahﷻ you made it for The Creator, didn’t make it for anyone you chose to do it because of The Creator, And by the way you know what you just did makes a lot of people angry, people who hate Islam, All these guys become Muslims, they're not happy to see that but Allahعزوجل is the one who guides you know, No matter how much people hate the Truth there will always be people coming to the Truth on a daily basis, So I'm happy to see you Jack and as I said anything just don't hesitate ask me straight away yeah? – OK, thank you! – OK, I'll remove you now, yeah? – Bye, thank you! – See you Assalamu Alaykum brother!
